title: Intention Service discovers the next legal question; it does not own legal semantics
summary: Legal Interrogation publishes transient specialist surfaces into Intention Service v0.1-dev11. Intention Service owns conversational recognition, CLARIFY/CONFIRM/READY, refresh/replacement and dispatch. Legal Interrogation owns the examination state machine and Legal Effect owns legal decision semantics.
invariants: Discovery surfaces are advisory availability statements, not authority grants.
Discovery refresh replaces stale domain evidence/surfaces rather than accumulating permanent startup truth.
Unchanged legal examination state must preserve the same discovery identity/generation.
A legal mutation must change discovery identity so retained decisions can be refreshed or invalidated.
A READY decision may activate an advertised legal-interrogation operation only if the bound session revision is still current.
